manifest.name: gdn-attn-q4k-mlp-early8-mid24-skip0
manifest.description: Extend the measured recurrent, attention and middle-MLP Q4_K recipe with MLP layers 1-8, retaining native recurrent/MLP layer zero and head. Test whether a short early MLP window improves quality while preserving performance. This recipe is unmeasured; its gain forecast fails adverse stress tests and its task, needle and holdout outcomes are unknown.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
